response.justification: Strong, long-tenured IC with 14+ years of software development and genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth (authored a D test runner and assertion library, built CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure, mobile device orchestration tooling, Selenium/TDD training). However, the resume shows no explicit people-management experience — no direct reports, hiring, performance reviews, or org-change leadership — which is the core requirement of this Level II Manager role. Staff Engineer titles and community teaching suggest technical leadership and mentoring potential, but the transition to formal people leadership would be unproven. Mobile-platform exposure is limited to a single iOS/tvOS stint a decade ago. Worth a conversation if the hiring team is open to a first-time manager with exceptional tooling credibility; otherwise a mismatch.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer-tooling and test-infrastructure background (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, IDE work at NI)
14+ years across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded with strong system design and TDD/craftsmanship practice
Demonstrated mentoring and organizational influence via workshops, courses, dojos, and open-source founding
concerns: No documented people management, direct reports, or performance-review experience
No evidence of leading organizational change or owning a team roadmap/priorities
Mobile-platform experience is thin and dated (single iOS/Apple TV stint ~2015-2016)

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
